requirements.title: Intrinsic procedures are inherent processor procedures
requirements.definition: Intrinsic procedures are defined as an inherent part of the processor.

pending.intrinsic-procedure-inherent-definition: PENDING source-use plan: cite this facet from future Clause 16 intrinsic fixtures that call a standard intrinsic such as ABS without an external procedure definition; compare exact ABS(-7)==7 against an EXTERNAL ABS sentinel route returning 35 to keep name resolution load-bearing.

requirements.oracle: The plan observes inherent availability only through a standard intrinsic with exact result and a companion external-name sentinel; intrinsic result semantics remain owned by Clause 16.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source registration creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Future fixture packets must establish a non-default positive state before observation, use one-property diagnostic controls for numbered constraints and syntax rules, and compare only exact scalar values, source admission, or required rejection. Diagnostic wording, exit status details, link-editor behavior, C linker labels, addresses, and processor-dependent intrinsic extensions are not portable oracles.

requirements.title: Processors include the Clause 16 intrinsic procedures
requirements.definition: A standard-conforming processor shall include the intrinsic procedures described in Clause 16.

requirements.title: Processors may provide additional intrinsic procedures
requirements.definition: A standard-conforming processor may include intrinsic procedures other than those described in Clause 16.

pending.additional-intrinsics-permitted: PENDING no-oracle record: a conforming processor is not required to provide any particular extra intrinsic, so no portable program may demand one.

requirements.title: Conforming programs use only Clause 16 intrinsic procedures as intrinsics
requirements.definition: A standard-conforming program shall not make use of intrinsic procedures other than those described in Clause 16.
